hypotheses.root_cause: Interconnect transaction timed out under fabric congestion: DMA burst length overflows the fabric buffers
hypotheses.rationale: Sustained high transaction-queue occupancy and stalls precede a transaction timeout and interconnect failure, suggesting QoS starvation or a potential deadlock on a congested route. Evidence contains the tell-tale(s) 'dma burst overflow', 'burst_len' for RC_DMA_BURST_OVERFLOW.
recommended_actions: Reduce the DMA burst length or add outstanding-transaction limits
Verify buffer depth on the DMA->DDR path
Review NoC QoS/arbitration weights for the starved initiator
Check for dependency cycles / deadlock on the congested route
